findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Inspector observed multiple boxes of food in the back storage area and front service area to be stored directly on the floor. PIC was informed that food items need to be stored a minimum of 6 inches off the ground to prevent contamination. Ensure food is stored off the floor before the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: Observed that the water in only employee restroom does not get hot. 5-202.12: (A) HANDWASHING SINK shall be equipped to provide water of a temperature at least 100F through mixing valve. Pf (B) Steam mixing valve may not be used. (C) A self-closing, slow-closing, or metered faucet shall provide at least 15 seconds of flowing water. (D) An automatic sink shall be installed to manufacturer’s guidelines. Repair or replace faucet so that the water reaches at least 100F according to code.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed floors throughout to be soiled. Snack aisle has loose snacks that appear to be cheese balls. Back food storage area has soil and food soil from spilling liquid dripped on the floor. 6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 
Clean and maintain clean.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111  (Pf) There is evidence of fresh pests throughout the snack aisle (6) and within the back room of the facility. See notes in General Comments: the candy at the front of the store was damaged and pest evidence present. Facility will need to get effective pest control to curtail the pest activity before the store is able to be opened. The pest specialist will be present tomorrow - see that traps are present throughout aisles to catch mice within snack station, candy at front of house, and also check pet supplies aisles. Remain closed until evidence of pests are removed.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11  (C) The ceiling tiles in the far back room are observed in a state of disrepair. Also, the lobby ceiling has been replaced, but the card aisle was observed covered with plastic to protect from a ceiling leak. See that the ceiling is repaired to protect building from water damage.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15  (Pf) Food packaging on multiple items within the Aisle 5 and 6 and within the back storage items are observed in poor condition due to mice utilizing them as a food supply. Food packaging must be in good condition so that foods are not exposed to adulteration or potential contamination. Reference 3-202.15. Foods were inspected and damaged foods discarded.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15  (C) Exterior door in back stock area has a large gap that allows access for pests. Exterior doors shall be: 1) self-closing, 2) solid and tight fitting, 3) limited to designed use. Reference 6-202.15. Repair or replace the door so that it is tight fitting and does not allow for rodents to enter.         
6-501.111  (Pf) Observed excessive evidence of live rodents (mice) in the facility. The premises shall be maintained free of insects, rodents and other pests. Eliminate pests and evident of infestation by using proper pest control and cleaning processes as needed. Reference 6-501.111.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.citation_text: 3-307.11  (C) Food is not protected from contamination in the back room dry storage area and on retail shelves of the facility. Rodents have access to the food as they are not being restricted from the facility. Food shall be protected from contamination. Reference 3-307.11. Also, boxes and bags of food are observed on the floor of the facility in various areas. Food should be protected from contamination at all times by storing it a minimum of 6 inches above the floor.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) and (C)  (C) Single-Use Articles are stored incorrectly. Observed a great number of boxes of single use items to be stored on the floor of the facility.  Single-Use Articles shall be stored: 1) in a clean and dry location; 2) away or protected from contamination; 3) at least six inches above the floor; 4) covered or inverted. Reference 4-903.11(A) and (C). Store items at least 6 inches above the floor so that cleaning can easily take place and rodent harborage is not created.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 (A & B) (C) Floors and shelves of retail section and floors in the facility in general are heavily soiled. Physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Except for cleaning up a spill or other accident, cleaning should be done during periods when the least amount of food is exposed such as after closing.  Reference 6-501.12 (A & B). Shelves in aisle 6 holding popcorn and animal crackers are heavily soiled with rodent feces and urine. The manager states that she cleaned them two weeks ago.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Edges of the blue bunny cooler are heavily soiled. Clean and maintain free of accumulated soil. 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: Observed that the toiled seat does not have a sanitary split. Replace seat with proper seat. 750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment: The in door hangs up and does not close completely. Repair door to close completely. 750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: Observed ceiling in the back and in the front to have soil accumulation around vents and some tiles that are soiled with water and or have holes. Clean ceilings and replace tiles as necessary. 750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text:
750.1220 - Floors in the following areas were observed to be soiled:
A) walkin cooler (food splash/debris under shelving);   and
B) under pallets in storage area (dust/debris).

Clean the floors under shelving and throughout daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text:
750.120 & 130 - Several boxes of food were observed on the floor in the walkin freezer and in the back storage room. All food must be stored up off the floor, including inside the walkin cooler and walkin freezer.
Food shall be protected at all times, and stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.
